scope: Prespecified matched positional-pooling ablation; frozen before training/scores. Same original training/validation data and seed; reserved scores excluded.
hypothesis: Whole-phrase temporal order may be lost by global pooling. A small depthwise filter over the eight remaining temporal positions may improve discrimination without changing the backbone, PCM, cadence or using a second stream. No improvement assumed.

initialization.inference_equivalence_gate: On fixed training representatives, frozen and learnable initial heads identical; within3e-6 of average-pooling topology. Export quantization remains a separate check.

selection: Select highest macro recall on validation at <=.5 continuous false events/hour, tie lower FAR then lower confusing rate then earlier checkpoint. Retain strict/near-phrase diagnostics; freeze before existing paired/long regression. No reserved scores, no acceptance without physical/resource/voice-chain tests.
followup_gate: Compare original-validation checkpoint/threshold, then freeze before old development regression. New depthwise topology requires separate MCU numerical/resource proof if promising. No acceptance from training or validation alone.
